items.source: with no replacement since introspection is added by default when adding a reflection hint for a type.
items.translation: 由于内省（introspection）默认已添加，因此无需替换，除非为某个类型添加反射提示时。

items.source: A category that represents reflective field access on declared fields: all fields defined by the class but not inherited fields.
items.translation: 表示对声明字段进行反射访问的类别：由类定义的所有字段，但不包括继承字段。

items.source: Contrary to other categories, this does not register any particular reflection for inner classes but rather makes sure they are available via a call to Class.getClasses().
items.translation: 与其他类别相反，这不会为内部类注册任何特定的反射，而是确保可以通过调用 Class.getClasses() 来访问它们。

items.source: Contrary to other categories, this does not register any particular reflection for inner classes but rather makes sure they are available via a call to Class.getDeclaredClasses().
items.translation: 与其他类别相反，这不会为内部类注册任何特定的反射，而是确保可以通过调用 Class.getDeclaredClasses() 来访问它们。

items.source: A category that represents reflective field access on public fields..
items.translation: 代表对公共字段进行反射访问的类别。

items.source: A category that defines all constructors can be invoked.
items.translation: 可以调用定义所有构造函数的类别。

items.source: A category that defines all methods, excluding inherited ones, can be invoked.
items.translation: 可以调用一个定义 所有方法（不包括继承的方法）的类别。

items.source: A category that defines public constructors can be invoked.
items.translation: 定义公共构造函数的类别可以调用。

items.source: A category that defines public methods, including inherited ones, can be invoked.
items.translation: 定义公共方法（包括继承的方法）的类别可以调用。

items.source: A category that represents the need for unsafe allocation for this type.
items.translation: 代表此类型需要unsafe allocation的类别。

items.source: A category that represents reflective field access on public fields.
items.translation: 代表对公共字段进行反射访问的类别。

items.source: A category that defines public constructors can be introspected but not invoked.
items.translation: 定义公共 构造函数 的类别可以反射，但无法调用。

items.source: A category that defines all constructors can be introspected but not invoked.
items.translation: 定义 所有构造函数 的类别可以反射，但无法调用。

items.source: A category that defines public methods, including inherited ones, can be introspected but not invoked.
items.translation: 定义公共 方法（包括继承的方法）的类别可以执行内省操作，但无法调用。

items.source: A category that defines all methods, excluding inherited ones, can be introspected but not invoked.
items.translation: 定义 所有方法（不包括继承的方法）的类别可以反射，但无法调用。
